observed_behavior: A pending worker needs integrated adoption tooling, but bootstrap requires the old dispatch scripts; an informal detached update breaks exact-path recovery.
expected_behavior: The original worker can receive an integrated adoption repair while preserving its dispatch identity and a resumable exact-path checkpoint.
causal_mechanism: One immutable dispatch revision was also the mutable recovery checkpoint, with no durable transition for receiving an integrated bootstrap repair before attachment.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Provenance and progress share one frozen value while the required prerequisite can change outside that checkpoint.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The prerequisite repair cannot reach the worker through the protocol; manually applying it invalidates recovery ownership.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Immutable dispatch provenance and original worker/action identity remain fixed while each Git transition has durable intent and completion.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: V2 bootstrap separates dispatch, completed and pending revisions; capability-owned upgrade pins the owning integration target before clean detached switching and resumes it through recovery.

applicability_conditions: The original worker is provisioned but not attached
Adoption requires tooling already integrated after dispatch
Exact-path recovery validates a committed checkpoint
known_non_matches: Host authorization refusal or missing Git objects
confirmation_evidence: The new real CLI fixture initially failed at neutral-cwd routing with exit 2
Original creation now upgrades, reconstructs and completes authenticated attachment
Actual ignored-file collision retains content and persisted intent
Six before/after-switch and missing/unregistered prefixes resume the same checkpoint
regression_proofs: tests/worker-worktrees.test.js: provisioned original worker upgrades integrated adoption tooling and retains exact-path recovery
tests/worker-worktrees.test.js: bootstrap upgrade resumes every durable prefix without changing dispatch identity
tests/worker-worktrees.test.js: bootstrap upgrade preserves an ignored collision and resumes the recorded intent after its removal
